cases.description: Create a valid DESIGN_SYSTEM.md from sufficient upstream evidence.
Input consists primarily of components, token values, or framework code.
Multiple products have distinct visual systems and partially conflicting patterns.
A proposed aesthetic or motion rule conflicts with accessibility or user control.
expected: Rejects or constrains the unsafe rule
Records a compliant alternative or open decision

cases.description: Required design system evidence across products is incomplete or contradictory.
expected: Does not invent cross-product patterns without evidence
Requests clarification on missing product design intent
prohibited: Fabricating shared design system patterns without evidence

cases.description: The request is to build a component library or token dictionary, not to define design system philosophy.
expected: Declines to use this skill for a component or token library request
Identifies that DESIGN_SYSTEM.md captures cross-product philosophy, not component implementations
Routes implementation work to the appropriate artifact
Does not produce a DESIGN_SYSTEM.md from implementation-level requests
prohibited: Creating DESIGN_SYSTEM.md from component or token library specifications
